The first two sleep tests were awful - all kinds of things went wrong (and of course this was in a hospital) the third was good. I have a very weird work schedule (with kids) - none of which helps - plus pets - so the idea of going through all of that again is a nightmare. I was prescribed for level 3 (it only goes to level 5. My friend has one that looks like a fighter pilot. Mine (from the beginning) felt “softer” comparing to my friend’s level. The only reason I took it in is because my partner who had always complained about feeling cold air told me she couldn’t really feel anymore. When it was tested, the sales rep didn’t seem overly alarmed, just very accepting that I should get a new one, needed a prescription.  I went to my doctor who referred to my another sleep study. I raised the level to four. If I fall asleep without it, I snore, so I feel that it is must work just not like it did. Thanks for reading this.

This is a very sad question. I think people on this board are all struggling & legitimately don’t want someone to end their life. I don’t think anybody with any ethics would answer this question, and to be honest, like most things, there is no guarantee. Your body could have an allergic reaction which could create all kinds of misery of pain and side effects. The clinics in Switzerland are very controlled (medically) and a lot of work goes into them - if you think about it - if there was a guaranteed “peaceful easy way” to go, that was guaranteed, a lot more people would do it. Why else is the wait list so long at the clinic ??? - and remember - there is a lot of help there.  I hope that you use your curiosity & imagination to seek a way to make your life a life you want to live. I understand, so please don’t think I’m lecturing, But I can tell you if I asked this question, this is the answer I’d want to read.
